subject: Bohmian mechanics

twelve_questions.1_physically_real: Universal wavefunction + actual particle positions (primitive ontology).
twelve_questions.2_primitive_variables: Configuration Q(t) guided by wavefunction psi(t) on configuration space.
twelve_questions.3_fundamental_dynamics: Two laws: Schrodinger equation for psi + guidance equation dQ/dt = (hbar/m) Im (psi* grad psi)/|psi|^2. MODIFIED ontology + added dynamics (Door D2, with dynamical component).
twelve_questions.4_probabilities_from: Equilibrium distribution rho=|psi|^2. Status: POSTULATED or argued via equivariance + typicality (Durr, Goldstein, Zanghi 1992 'Quantum equilibrium'). CONTESTED in literature (Valentini quantum-nonequilibrium proposals; critics argue typicality measure is itself an additional assumption).
twelve_questions.5_definite_outcomes: YES - particles always have positions. Measurement outcomes = pointer configurations. Definite outcomes are ONTOLOGICAL, not dynamical selection.
twelve_questions.6_recovers_unitary_sector: YES - psi obeys standard Schrodinger; effective collapse emerges via effective wavefunction for subsystems.
twelve_questions.7_recovers_classicality: YES - classical limit via effective dynamics (Nelson? see Durr et al. classical limit results).
twelve_questions.8_additional_inputs_beyond_Cbp: ALTERED ONTOLOGY (D2 door): added particle positions as part of the state. Guidance equation is added dynamics. Equilibrium hypothesis rho=|psi|^2 is an additional assumption (or argued via typicality which is itself an assumption).
twelve_questions.9_empirical_inputs: Same standard-model inputs; no additional empirical constants.
twelve_questions.10_novel_predictions: CONTESTED. In quantum equilibrium (rho=|psi|^2) Bohmian predictions = standard QM (no new prediction). Valentini nonequilibrium scenario allows deviations (subquantum measurement, modified interferometry) but requires cosmological initial conditions producing rho != |psi|^2 - UNOBSERVED and cosmology-dependent. NOT an established discriminating prediction (H2 FAILS for standard Bohm).
twelve_questions.11_falsification: Only via nonequilibrium detection (Valentini; e.g., relic particles from early universe). No current positive evidence. Standard Bohm is empirically equivalent to standard QM within equilibrium hypothesis.
twelve_questions.12_unexplained_remainder: Why rho=|psi|^2 initially (typicality/contested). Preferred foliation needed for relativistic extension UNRESOLVED (Bohmian field theory constructions exist but no fully satisfactory Lorentz-invariant version). Guidance law's form not derived from deeper principle (Durr et al. symmetry arguments contested).
